findings.title: The reviewed implementation is not a deployable Solana program
evidence: The branch contains a network-free JavaScript state model and proposed JSON ABI
The interface explicitly reports network NONE and unapplied/deployable-false gates
No executable Anchor/Solana program implements the modeled guards
impact: Atomic transfers, PDA uniqueness, account ownership, CPI restrictions, final-slot concurrency, rent, and upgrade behavior cannot be established
Model tests cannot authorize funding or activation
remediation: Implement the final isolated program without copying production V2 code
Test Rust host, SBF/local-validator, contention, failure rollback, and signed Devnet flows
Audit the exact final source and reproducible binary independently

findings.title: X Premium is absent from policy, attestations, and settlement guards
evidence: The proposal tree has no Premium or subscription_type requirement
Attestation payloads bind node, wallet, and X commitment only
A verified boolean can represent a non-Premium X account
impact: The owner-required per-pair qualification and economic cost are bypassed
Non-Premium pairs can consume the entire 1,000-pair budget in the model
remediation: Bind allowed X Premium tier and observed-at time inside the signed canonical attestation
Fail closed on missing, unknown, stale, downgraded, or unverifiable status
Publish revalidation and X outage behavior

findings.title: A proposer can reserve a hero indefinitely
evidence: A nomination stores createdAt but no expiresAt
Only the proposer can cancel a pending nomination
Pending nominations expire only when pair 1,000 exhausts the whole campaign
impact: One qualifying proposer pair can deny one target hero for the lifetime of the campaign
Permitted multi-account operators can buy many durable target locks
remediation: Add a bounded nomination TTL
Allow permissionless deterministic expiry cleanup
Specify hero rejection and race ordering against settlement

findings.title: An active campaign has no timeout, emergency cancellation, or residual refund path
evidence: cancel_campaign_pre_activation rejects ACTIVE
Surplus finalization is available only after exactly 1,000 pairs
A low-demand or disabled-verifier campaign can remain active indefinitely
impact: Up to 180,000 IAT can remain locked indefinitely
Emergency verifier disable stops attestations but does not recover the promotional vault
remediation: Specify immutable timeout and emergency terminal states
Require refund only to the pre-bound community account
Prevent reopening and preserve complete public accounting

findings.title: Verifier truth, reviewer threshold, and identity-commitment custody remain unresolved trust assumptions
evidence: The state engine consumes a verified boolean
The detached signature adapter proves which key signed, not whether X, Premium, wallet, and node facts are true
STATUS lists verifier key, reviewer threshold, and pepper custody as open decisions
impact: A compromised or dishonest verifier can manufacture qualifying pairs until the cap
A compromised pepper may enable identity correlation or targeted reservation
remediation: Define independent threshold issuance and review
Publish key lifecycle and emergency-stop authority
Log privacy-preserving outcomes and conduct an external trust-boundary review

findings.title: The reference engine does not itself prove the mainnet Genesis anchor
evidence: createCampaign accepts a caller-provided genesisTimestamp
activateCampaign checks a MAINNET string and elapsed seconds
The proposed ABI names verified_genesis_config but no executable owner/type/content checks exist
impact: An incorrect anchor can open the model before verified Genesis plus eight hours
The proposed interface cannot yet demonstrate exact cluster or record ownership binding
remediation: Define the canonical Genesis account owner, discriminator, content, and finality requirements
Test exact T+8h-1 and T+8h boundaries against the executable program

findings.title: The node deduplication dimension is not reconciled with the accepted participant unit
evidence: Owner policy defines one wallet plus immutable X ID plus X Premium as one qualifying unit
The proposal independently rejects and rewards by node ID as a third identity key
impact: A regenerated or shared node record may unexpectedly deny a valid wallet/X/Premium pair
Public eligibility rules and executable markers can disagree
remediation: Define node identity as a binding attribute or remove it as an independent human proxy
Add migration, rotation, and collision rules without imposing proof of personhood

findings.title: Handle resolution, display consent, and commitment privacy remain incomplete
evidence: The reference engine accepts a hero commitment and display handle without a resolver proof
Public-handle display consent and pepper custody remain open decisions
impact: A displayed handle can be stale, unwanted, or mismatched to the reserved commitment
Weak commitment derivation can expose immutable X IDs to dictionary attack
remediation: Bind resolver evidence to the nomination
Require hero display consent before publication
Use domain-separated keyed commitments with audited custody and rotation
